notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!

We’ve released a small but important patch for the Leif’s Adventure demo! This update improves the overall experience, making it a better reflection of the full game.

One of the key enhancements is the camera system, which is now more responsive, ensuring better visibility during gameplay. This change makes platforming and combat feel more fluid, bringing the demo closer to experience of the main game.

[previewyoutube=n8bQpkxYdBc;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now is the perfect time to jump in and see the improvements for yourself!  Thanks for all your support and we’d love to hear your feedback.

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!

We've released a new update to enhance your journey through Leif's Adventure: Netherworld Hero. Check out the details below:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Resolved an issue when buying skills at the dojo. If you're affected, talk to the dojo owner again about the skill you purchased.
[*] Fixed camera escape problems to improve visual consistency.
[*] Prevented the spider boss from being triggered outside its battle room.
[*] Corrected missing wall and ceiling colliders.
[*] Fixed geometry in the Crimson Quarry to allow the boulder to be properly blocked when rolling it to the right wall.
[*] Addressed an edge hang issue that disrupted smooth navigation.
[*] Corrected misaligned Crimson Quarry map, adding missing portal and save point symbols.
[*] Fixed journal quest entries not being marked complete after finishing them.
[*] Resolved typos across the game text.
[*] Fixed wrong shopping icons and input symbol positioning on PS5.
[*] Fixed a blocker when exiting the broken cave through the entrance, ensuring level progression.
[*] Fixed some missing sound effects.[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*] Enhanced camera behavior for a smoother and more immersive gaming experience.
[*] Enlarged the exit from the rotating wheel in Tigros Kingdom for easier navigation.
[*] Added an autosave just after the Ice Golem Mini-Boss to safeguard your progress.[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list][*] Removed weapon interaction with shrine backgrounds to prevent unnecessary weapon damage.
[*] Fixed hammer upgrade achievements. If you've already upgraded your hammer, simply revisit the corresponding statues to unlock the achievement.
[*] Changed some sound effects from 3D to 2D for a better experience.[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to let us know. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

Thank you so much for playing my game and I already got some interesting feedback from you guys, including some annoying bugs. I have manage to fix a few, as listed below, and I will continue to fix bugs and update the game. Expect a new update soon!

Here's a list of fixes I made so far:

[list]
[*] Added correct conditions for Hummbie first contact Conversation
[*] Added condition for Airattack door so it is deactivated when buying airattack at dojo
[*] Added additional platforms to be able to move upwards the waterfall
[*] Added more time for Tendrill respawn in Bossfight
[*] Added the term "short" before Sword attack. To make clear that it is only for short swords.
[*] Exchanged Attackspeed with Damage wording in Shop legend
[*] Fixed typo "bissigene" to "bissige" for Minjaar Brother conversation
[*] Added logic to activate the specific Camera Focus depending on where the player stands during Treehouse conversation.
[*] Changed SpawnPerHit Varable to 1 for all treasure chests. This might help fight the multi spawn for treasure chests.
[/list]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Gamedevelopment Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Bossfight - a new challenge awaits you.[/h1]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hjvK2HLq/Boss.png[/img]

This month was all about creating the boss fight for the sulfite ground. Creating a boss enemy is always a fun process but also a bit taxing. The goal is to create a specific gameplay element that is different for each boss. As important is to use both characters' capabilities. Leif nor Ghost should be bored during the fight. Similar to the level I start with some rough ideas. Thereafter I block out the elements that are now to this boss enemy. To see if the ideas do work as planned. If this is successful the next step is to add the other attacks and movements. To see if all movements work together. During the whole process, a lot of playtesting is needed. I also make sure the art assets and animations do look good. And in the end, we hopefully have an engaging and challenging boss fight.


[h2]Cutscenes - The story needs to be told.[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cCQ13f7K/CS.png[/img]

Since this boss is the last level boss, the story of course also slowly comes to a head. Therefore, cutscenes are needed that properly set the scene for the individual characters and advance the story. For this, I have made a few streams on Twitch and Steam in the last few days. The streams will be available for a few days. But maybe I'll make a Youtube video out of it later in a shorter form.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/onemanonmars] Twitch Stream[/url]

[h2]The Bard - a new face[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/T19MG0qc/bard-anim-prev.gif[/img]

Since the singer for the intro has changed I also wanted to adapt the representation of his character as the bard. So, say hello to the new bard and have a look at his lute playing skills. If you haven't seen the intro video yet. Check it out below.

[url=https://youtu.be/MsV2Rve3xb0]Intro [/url]


[h2]Have a great holiday season![/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6qBgHRJ4/Xmas-card.jpg[/img]

The Christmas season is just around the corner and it's getting dark outside my office window very early again. I wish you all a great festive season and a good start to the winter season.

notes.title: Gamedevelopment Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you for a great Steam Next Fest[/h1]

the Steam Next Festival was great fun and now it's time for a cold drink and a summer filled with more gaming fun. Let's take a look at the latest dev updates:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/518ee65cdba89dc7cc4979ee6335746e8de0154b.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Extended Demo Out[/h2]
The new extended demo is out on Steam. Have you picked up the sword and jumped right into battle? There is lot's to explore in this new version of the demo. You can around and explore the ancient pyramid or jump through one of the two portals to go on a quest in Red Rock or Broken Cave. But keep your eyes open for the Ancient Monster. They are hidden somewhere and are waiting for you!

[h2]Development Update[/h2]
I have been busy implementing new features into the game. One of them is a new map feature, that will show you some interesting information about each level. You will be able to see if you have found every treasure or all ancient weapons of a level and much more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/9946f493fd2c1943f8c7bea455c1fda66ef80b40.png[/img]

To make it easier for the players to keep track of all the open tasks I started integrating the Quest Journal. This way you should never lose the overview of the things to do in Leif's Adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/95b48693ab4466117c943bd8f561f16c024ff743.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay tipp[/h2]
The relationship between Leif and Ghost is a very important aspect of the game.
Check out how the ghost can support Leif in battles by catching Leif's "lost health"! This can make quite the difference! Work as a team to collect the hearts and support each other. Play the new demo with a friend and share the fun!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FsYV0h5b/ezgif-com-gif-maker-1.gif[/img]

[h2]Meet the Ariiborians[/h2]
In the new demo, you get to explore Ariibora and meet the inhabitants. There is much to uncover! Enter the dojo! Give your new weapons a try or talk to Paaros the Weapon Master! Once equipped for battle help the Arrioborans to find the missing queen and learn more about the evil that is threatening the peace.

Have you ever wondered how all these characters came to life?
Check out this timelapse video of the creation of the Ariiborians.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/h4zrNVpW/timelaps-cloudhubs.gif[/img]
